name: Better Discord Notifications
description: Rich Discord messages for Fledge notifications: colour-coded embeds with the server, the cause, a link to the panel and the last console lines. Works for administrators' and customers' Discord channels.
author: Fledge

styles.label: Rich embed
styles.description: Colour-coded card with fields, a link and a footer.

styles.label: Compact embed
styles.description: A slim, colour-coded line. Good for busy channels.

settings.label: Sender name
settings.help: The name Discord shows for the messages. Leave empty to use your panel's name from Appearance.

settings.label: Sender picture (https link)
settings.help: Optional. Must be an https link to an image. Leave empty to use the picture set on the Discord webhook.

settings.label: Link titles to the panel
settings.help: The title opens the server or page in your panel. Only your panel's own address is used.

settings.label: Show the time
settings.help: Discord shows it in each reader's own time zone.

settings.label: Show the event code in the footer
settings.help: For example server.crashed. Handy when you filter or search.

settings.label: Show the last console lines of a crash
settings.help: Server output can contain player names and chat. Turn this off if the Discord channel is more public than the panel.

settings.label: Colour: needs attention
settings.help: Six hex digits, for example ED4245.

settings.label: Discord role to ping (administrators' channels only)
settings.help: The numeric ID of a role (turn on Developer Mode in Discord, then right-click the role and choose Copy Role ID). Customers' channels never ping anyone.

options.label: Things that need attention (crashes, offline nodes, failed payments)
Warnings and things that need attention
